concept.label: The Concept
concept.title: The Sunk Value Concept
body: Every organization contains hidden value: unused knowledge, underutilized assets, market access, brand equity, operational capabilities, and strategic relationships.
Sunk Value converts these dormant resources into productive economic value through structured concept design, business modeling, and market activation.

model.label: The Model
model.title: The Value Creation Model
model.body: We combine market analysis, business strategy, resource activation, proof-of-concept validation, and venture management to transform opportunities into executable growth models.

products.label: The Products
products.title: Products of Strategic Value
products.body: Sunk Value creates business products that help organizations enter new markets, build new ventures, activate partnerships, and transform internal capabilities into external growth opportunities.

cards.title: Venture Models
cards.body: Business structures designed to convert hidden opportunities into scalable ventures.

cards.title: Innovation Labs
cards.body: Focused environments for testing concepts, building prototypes, and validating market potential.

cards.title: Incubation Hubs
cards.body: Platforms that connect founders, experts, resources, and strategic partners.

cards.title: Market Entry Programs
cards.body: Structured programs that help organizations enter new segments with clarity and speed.

cards.title: Strategic Partnerships
cards.body: Partnership models that combine capabilities, networks, and shared market access.

cards.title: Growth Platforms
cards.body: Scalable products and programs designed to generate long-term economic impact.

capabilities.label: The Capabilities
capabilities.title: Capabilities Behind the Wave
capabilities.intro: Our team supports organizations with the expertise, mentoring, and development capabilities required to move from strategic idea to market execution.

cards.title: Expertise
cards.body: Access to industry best practices, market knowledge, advisory insight, and business model validation.

cards.title: Mentoring
cards.body: Active coaching that helps teams progress with clarity, discipline, and measurable direction.

cards.title: Development
cards.body: Transfer of practical expertise to client teams so they know exactly what to build, manage, and scale.

createWave.label: Create a Wave
createWave.title: Create Your Next Wave
createWave.body: Every market shift creates a new wave. Sunk Value helps you see it earlier, design it smarter, and launch it with the right model, resources, and partners.
